bio: You can rely on chef Chatchai Klanklong (L'Orchidée) and his brother Kriankai to concoct flavoursome Thai cuisine, such as Tom Yam (prawn and coconut milk soup), or 30-day aged Iberico pork chop with cauliflower and spiced tamarind jus... Premium ingredients, distinctive, well-balanced flavours, precise culinary technique and careful presentation....
